name: Ranger Headshots Only: Serrated Shot ticks stack a buff the next Precision Shot consumes (#1299)
contract: Headshots Only 680931 reads 'Periodic damage dealt with Serrated Shot and Toxic Dart now increases the damage of your next Precision Shot within $573202d by $573202s1%, stacking $573202u times.' and its buff 573202 reads 'Damage of your next Precision Shot increased by $S1%. Stacks $u times.' 680931's only effect is SPELL_AURA_PROC_TRIGGER_SPELL on 573202; Spell.dbc ProcFlags 0, revived by the spell_proc row in rev_20260921_40_ranger_dead_procs.sql (PROC_FLAG_DONE_PERIODIC, family 27 masks 32768/-/128 = Toxic Dart and Serrated Shot). 573202 is an 8 sec (DurationIndex 31) self aura, StackAmount 10, SPELL_AURA_ADD_PCT_MODIFIER SPELLMOD_DAMAGE +10% on EffectSpellClassMask (0,8388608,0) = Precision Shot's SpellFamilyFlags. Its Spell.dbc ProcCharges is 0, so no Precision Shot ever used it up: the whole stack simply lasted 8 sec. Expected: a Serrated Shot tick grants 573202; a fresh 573202 carries one charge; the next Precision Shot that lands removes it (about 3.6 sec into its 8 sec duration, so natural expiry cannot explain the removal). Before the fix the charge assertion reads 0 and the buff is still present after the Precision Shot.
